purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Catalogue of Life and ChecklistBank documentation, taxonomic and name-usage guidance, ColDP standards, releases, downloads, APIs, data contribution workflows, licensing, citation instructions, and governance context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Catalogue of Life, ChecklistBank, and the cited source datasets remain authoritative for taxonomic content, source provenance, release versions, API behavior, licenses, citations, legal terms, and contact information.

notes: Verify current API base paths, versions, OpenAPI locations, authentication, and rate limits.
Distinguish Catalogue of Life APIs from ChecklistBank APIs and static download products.
Capture endpoint parameters, pagination, filter syntax, response schemas, identifiers, errors, examples, and deprecations.
Do not infer undocumented write endpoints or privileged dataset-management functions.
Capture exact release- and source-dataset-level license wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate Catalogue of Life release rights from contributor dataset rights, software licenses, references, and external identifiers.
Preserve dataset provider, source identifier, source version, license URI, citation, and release provenance.
Do not assume the aggregate checklist license overrides stricter source-dataset conditions.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Catalogue of Life and ChecklistBank paths, API versions, and OpenAPI locations may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every taxon, name usage, source dataset, release, or ChecklistBank record when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store API keys, passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, privileged dataset credentials, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Catalogue of Life releases, source datasets, vernacular names, references, distributions, software, and APIs may carry different rights.
Always preserve source dataset, source identifier, source version, license, citation, release identifier, and provenance.
